instruction: Reach and grab the light brown wooden roller with both arms

source.instruction: Reach and grab the light brown wooden roller with both arms

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the roller, which was at x = -4 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the roller, which was at x = -4 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Orient left gripper downward, rotate yaw 90 degrees, and move to (-13, -15, 94) above the left end of the roller.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+18, +4, +0) cm, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the roller

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, -15, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper to z=84 cm. Orient right gripper downward, rotate yaw 90 degrees, and move towards the right end of the roller.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -10) cm, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the roller; RIGHT fingertips moved by (-13, -0, +0) cm, now 22 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the roller

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-12, -15, 84) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (18, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper to align at (5, -15, 84) above the right side of the roller and lower to z=84 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-12, +4, -10) cm, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +10 cm (vertical) from the roller

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-12, -15, 84) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (5, -15, 84) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper further to grasp height z=78 cm around the left end of the roller.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -6) cm, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the roller

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-12, -15, 78) opening 0.91; RIGHT fingertips (5, -15, 84) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right gripper to grasp height z=78 cm, then close both grippers to grasp the roller.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the roller; closed the gripper (opening 0.26: holding the roller); RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -6) cm, now 9 cm (horizontal) / +3 cm (vertical) from the roller; closed the gripper (opening 0.26: holding the roller)

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-12, -15, 78) opening 0.26; RIGHT fingertips (5, -15, 78) opening 0.26; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift both arms to raise the roller off the tabletop.
